Digital Marketing Specialist

Responsibility:

The Digital Marketing Specialist will be responsible for managing and optimizing our Search Engine Optimization (SEO), Pay-Per-Click (PPC) campaigns, social media marketing, and overall web presence. This role requires a hands-on individual with proven experience in these areas, capable of analyzing data to make informed decisions and continuously improving our digital performance.

Key Responsibilities

  • Take ownership of search engine and social media marketing.
  • Develop and execute a comprehensive SEO strategy.
  • Manage and optimize Google Ads and PPC campaigns.
  • Develop, implement, and manage the social media strategy across key platforms.
  • Analyse website traffic and campaign performance using Google Analytics.
